description: This header file declares the TTSURLConstructer class responsible for constructing URLs used in a Text-To-Speech (TTS) system. It includes method declarations for URL construction, sanitization, and string manipulation related to TTS configuration.

classes.name: TTSURLConstructer
classes.description: A class that handles URL construction and related string sanitization for TTS configurations.

methods.name: constructURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL based on the TTS configuration, input text, and fallback/local flags.

methods.name: httpgetURL
methods.description: Generates an HTTP GET URL for the TTS request.

methods.name: httppostURL
methods.description: Generates an HTTP POST URL for the TTS request.

methods.name: sanitizeString
methods.description: Sanitizes an input string to ensure it is suitable for URL or request usage.

methods.name: isSilentPunctuation
methods.description: Checks if a character is silent punctuation that should be ignored during processing.

methods.name: replaceSuccesivePunctuation
methods.description: Replaces successive punctuation in a string to normalize it.

methods.name: replaceIfIsolated
methods.description: Replaces isolated instances of a substring within another string, with an option to skip isolation checking.

methods.name: curlSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes the URL to be compatible with cURL constraints.
